text:
Nina L: handing off to night -> Omar R. Leaving context for INC-2026-88 (kv-cache eviction + embeddings backlog). Active alerts and mitigations below.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-88 created (kv-cache-evictions-us-west), severity=P2. Pager sent to eng-oncall.

Nina L: TL;DR: us-west kv nodes are thrashing causing p99s on generation and embeddings. Embeddings backlog ~2.1k, two paying customers seeing 504s (acme-health, blueprint). Primary tonight: Omar R (primary), Kai M (secondary). I'm available for 20m after handoff for quick Qs.

Jules P: quick note - saw repeated OOMs on kv-worker-3 (us-west-2b) at ~19:12 UTC. I cordoned the node and restarted the deployment. Evictions dropped briefly but then resumed.

Nina L: Current signals:
- metrics: kv_cache.evictions_per_min > 6k (us-west cluster).
- embeddings.queue.length = ~2100 (p95 latency 24s).
- http.504.rate for acme-health ~1.1% of their traffic since 19:00 UTC.

Actions I already ran:
1) Increased kv eviction threshold for us-west primaries to 80% via config push (temporary, 45m).
2) Scaled embeddings-worker deployment from 2 -> 6 replicas (kubectl scale deployment/embeddings-worker -n inference-us --replicas=6). Queue drained ~35% in 7m.
3) Enabled routing fallback for acme-health to route to dedicated-emb-2: `feature.toggle('route:acme:d2',true)`
4) Enabled prefix prefetch on hot prefixes for 30m: `kv.prefetch.set(['sess:user:*','doc:hot:*'])`

Omar R: acknowledged. Plan for my shift:
- Monitor kv_cache.evictions_per_min and kv.mem_utilization dashboards.
- If evictions > 10k/min sustained for 10m: perform eviction-controller restart per runbook. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-recovery (section: controller-restart). Command: `kubectl -n infra restart deployment/eviction-controller`
- If embeddings p95 > 30s after scaling: reduce embeddings.batch_size to 6 and scale replicas to 8. Admin config API: POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/config {"embeddings.batch_size":6}.
- Keep routing fallback enabled for impacted customers until their 5xxs drop below 0.2% for 15m.

Kai M: I'll pick up as secondary for the first 4 hours, then @Nina L will resume backup after 23:00 UTC. If primary needs to escalate, I'll open a platform-ops ticket.

Jules P: noted a small mismatch in KV RPO between racks (sync_delay ~350ms). If sync_delay > 500ms open infra ticket and consider cold failover steps. You can monitor sync offset: `curl https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?expr=kv_sync_offset{region=\"us-west\"}`

Nina L: runbook pointers:
- kv eviction: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-recovery (recommended sequence: raise threshold -> restart eviction-controller -> cordon/reboot node).
- embeddings queue: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue (section: emergency-scaling).

incident-bot: Pager for INC-2026-88 escalated at 19:20 UTC to oncall team.

Omar R: operational checklist for night:
- Watch `infra/us-west/kv` dashboard and `apps/embeddings-queue`.
- If OOMs reoccur on kv-worker pods after restart: consider draining that node and performing a soft reboot (`node.reboot = true` via infra tool).
- If more than 2 paying customers see >0.5% 504s, escalate to SEV-1 process (notify execs and CS).

Jules P: I left a grep snippet for noisy keys that are causing rehydration loops: `kubectl logs -l app=kv-worker -n production-us | grep -E 'rehydrate|prefetch'`. Two prefixes are hot: `sess:user:active:*` and `doc:embed:hot:*`. I temporarily added a short TTL on those prefixes to reduce churn.

CS-bot: CS tickets opened: CS-10021 (acme-health), CS-10023 (blueprint). CS has been updated with the status page link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-88 and will post external updates at :15/:45.

Nina L: customer impact summary for handoff:
- acme-health: intermittent 504s impacting their ingestion pipelines (approx 9% of requests failing between 19:00-19:30 UTC). Engineering contact assigned, CS engaged.
- blueprint: delayed bulk imports, timeouts for some multipart uploads.
- Most other customers: elevated latency but not erroring.

Omar R: special notes:
- If you need to check quick health from CLI:
```bash
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?expr=kv_cache_evictions_per_min{region='us-west'}" | jq .
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?expr=embeddings_queue_length" | jq .
```
- Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/INC-2026-88. Pod describe example saved in attachments.

Nina L: outstanding TODOs for night shift: 
- [Omar] Monitor evictions and decide on eviction-controller restart if threshold hits 10k/min for >10m.
- [Kai] Keep CS updated every 30m and confirm fallback effectiveness for acme-health & blueprint.
- [Jules] Watch node OOMs and sync_offset. If sync_offset climbs >500ms, open infra ticket.
- [Nina] I will check back in at 20:00 UTC for a quick sync and then hand off final backup duties at 23:00 UTC.

Omar R: ack, taking primary. Ping me in DM for anything urgent in the first 15m. :thumbsup: 

Jules P: acked. I'll maintain node checks.

Kai M: ack and standing by as secondary.

incident-bot: Handoff documented. Next handback scheduled 2026-04-08T07:00:00Z.
